detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:03. The shot begins from <Picture 4>: a full shot from behind, low on the flagstones at the corridor's far end: <Subject 2> through the low arched passage holding its door open, <Subject 1>'s back nearer the camera, bareheaded, the brown bowler in the hand on the left of frame, the black stick planted under the bare hand on the right of frame, weight on the stick. The camera holds a static shot as <Subject 1> limps along on his stick at a normal walking pace down the corridor toward the passage, two full strides, growing smaller in frame, from 00:00 to 00:02. At 00:02 <Subject 2> stands in the open doorway at the far end with his hand on the door, and the opening continues to the last frame of the shot. Behind them a nurse in a white cap and long apron at a dun-coloured door with a covered tray level in both hands, and a charwoman beyond her with both hands on her pail, from 00:00 to 00:03. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:03 while he limps along on his stick at a normal walking pace down the corridor toward the passage.
[Shot 2] From 00:03 to 00:07. At 00:03 the shot cuts to an insert low at the corridor's far end, from behind, beginning from <Picture 5>: <Subject 1>'s boot on the worn flagstone with the black stick's ferrule planted beside it, a bar of window light across them; ahead, the threshold of the low arched passage and the door; only what <Picture 5> shows is in frame. The camera is set down on the flagstones at the corridor's far end a half pace behind Watson's boots, a hand's breadth above the stone and level with it, a close-focus lens looking along the floor toward the low arched passage. The camera holds a static shot as the boot lifts, swings forward through a full stride and lands a step nearer the passage, from 00:03 to 00:04. At 00:04 the stick's ferrule lifts and plants beside it. At 00:06 the bar of window light passes over them, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot.

overall_soundscape: The ambience of a long stone corridor inside Saint Bartholomew's Hospital runs under the whole take: its own air, the surfaces underfoot and the fabric of the room around it. Cloth, boots, wood and glass carry the physical action, and the movement and low murmur of the people at work nearby carry under it throughout.
